notes: nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b for LiteRT (litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b): nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (revision ea30d66d, openmdw-1.1), a cache-aware streaming FastConformer encoder with an RNN-T decoder and a language prompt, rewritten as plain PyTorch graphs (no NeMo) and exported with litert-torch 0.10.0 for LiteRT 2.3.0 at lookahead 3 (320 ms chunks): mel, pre (the subsampling with its convolution caches), the 24-layer conformer with its attention and convolution caches as graph inputs and outputs, and the RNN-T decoder (predict, joint); the host carries the caches from chunk to chunk and runs the greedy RNN-T loop (at most 10 tokens per encoder frame). The float16 conformers scale each of their 144 LayerNorm inputs by 2^-k (k 2-9) so float16 arithmetic stays finite. Accuracy = WER (CER for FLEURS Japanese) against the reference: transformers 5.22.1 Nemotron3_5AsrForRNNT in float32 on the same chunks with the same 5,520 zeros appended, greedy decoding, each set's language-locale as the prompt; L = the Open ASR Leaderboard's scoring, J = jiwer on the same normalized text. This file: nemotron_asr_mel.tflite (964,732 B; the card's Files table: log-mel front end: `mel_first` (the first 4,040 samples → 25 frames) and `mel` (5,520 samples → 32 frames); backend CPU). artifact_sha256 = = the work graph mel.tflite that the phones were sent (the phone's sha256 read-back MATCH in each frame). LANDED: nemotron_asr_mel.tflite (sha256 dc6f59d2f3be10be63b775905980e61ba9816092ec4f2448cd57fb6e695d6f6d, 964,732 B) is in litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b from commit b2a2190cd36b4ca2e43a4f77b5af4c0165db559f (uploaded 2026-11-03 14:02 JST); the Hub tree read at 2026-11-03T14:15:43+09:00 (main b2a2190c) gives this LFS oid and size. Galaxy S26, 2026-11-02: for each form that loads this file, the runs behind the card's Performance row (two runs, A B B A), its Sustained bullet and S4 / J200 columns, and the GPU bullet's runs — GPU: S4 s9b_g16_copy_s4, T s5ts_g16_copy_a1, T s5ts_g16_copy_a2, T s5ts_g16_swap_b1, T s5ts_g16_swap_b2; NPU: T r4s2e1_npu_fused_b1, T r4s2e1_npu_fused_b2. Runners: nemotron-runner; nemotron-runner-r2. Not records: the other setting of each A B B A pair, whose median the card prints at most as the comparison (split 27.546 ms; t6copy 50.258 ms); the cold JIT compile runs (their partition line is cited); the runs the card's Notes or usage text cite for one fact each (r4s1c_npu_pre, r4s1npu_pre_s32, r4s2c_npu_pre, r4s2e1_npu_split_a1, r4s2e1_npu_split_a2, r4s3c_npu_pre, r4s4c_npu_pre, r6s1c7_fp16ws_fc_t6copy_a1, r6s1c7_fp16ws_fc_t6copy_a2, rs7d_npu_s4, the A B B A arms and cold runs among them); the card's usage-block runs; and every run of a form that is not Records written.
